senses.sense_definition: Simple past and past participle of <w>arrest</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Having been taken into custody by legal authority or charged with a crime.

examples.text: The <w>arrested</w> man refused to answer any questions without his lawyer present.

target_lang_translations.ru: <w>Арестованный</w> мужчина отказался отвечать на вопросы без присутствия своего адвоката.
target_lang_translations.nl: De <w>gearresteerde</w> man weigerde vragen te beantwoorden zonder dat zijn advocaat aanwezig was.

target_lang_translations.de: Der <w>verhaftete</w> Mann weigerte sich, ohne seinen Anwalt Fragen zu beantworten.
target_lang_translations.fr: L'homme <w>arrêté</w> a refusé de répondre à toute question sans la présence de son avocat.

examples.text: Officers transported the <w>arrested</w> individuals to the central station for processing.
